## Deploy readiness board (R100, informational)

This check is informational on pull requests during the pre-launch
burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,
env discovery, operator keys) are surfaced below but do not block the
PR because the runner carries no production secrets. The prod-deploy
gate (deploy-readiness-gate) enforces every section under strict mode.

```
================ DEPLOY READINESS BOARD (R100) ================
    mode: INFORMATIONAL (PR / pre-launch)
    
    --- STUB VALUES [RED=0] ---
```

OPENING (B-661-R7-117, agent 117) — growth-project-backend#702 @ 5c25122def8d688bcdf1ba3bdf1ea6898bf750b8

Tests-only PR for #661 fix round 7 (FIX ROUND 7 comment 5977850515 at `c76491692fd03b7304416cf68c7589098f9817ea`), base `agent/clinic/b-secrets-3`. It exists because the operator's SIZE ASSESSMENT on #661 (5977489245) allows no net growth there. Lands with #661 as one unit; never retarget it to main on its own.

Commits: `617add10` (the tests, on #661 round 6 `c7ee15f0`; the failing-before commit) and `5c25122d` (merge of #661 round 7 `c7649169`, no conflict). Diff against the base: one file, `test/checkout-settlement.live.spec.ts`, +231 / -4.

| Finding | Test | Before (`c7ee15f0`) | After (this head) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-661-3 (Sol, 5977638148): the owner lookup capped all failed rows of the PaymentIntent at ten before checking activation | `B-661-3 round 7: the owner query is complete at any number of adopted purchases` -> `the activated owner recovers behind %i never-activated purchases adopted onto its PaymentIntent; they gain nothing and nothing runs twice` (9, 10, 12) | 10 and 12 fail with `{ claimed: false, reason: 'checkout_session_activates' }`; 9 passes (control) | 3 / 3 pass |

What the cases do: real native reservations through `CheckoutService.createPaymentIntentForClient` (provider replies held), each adopted onto the owner's PaymentIntent by a real `payment_intent.payment_failed` delivery (metadata fallback) in its own held transaction; the owner's real `checkout.session.completed` activates it, a real failure revokes it, the same PaymentIntent then succeeds. Unordered purchase reads are answered newest first (findMany) / oldest first (findFirst), a legal order the code under test does not exclude. Assertions: the boundary itself (`count + 1` failed rows, one activation record, an unfiltered ten-row read misses the owner from ten on); the owner recovers once (`payment_recovered`, paid, entitled, drop pending, no second split descriptor, one PurchaseFanout row); the adopted purchases gain nothing; after the native replies land each adopted purchase holds its own PaymentIntent and stays unentitled; a redelivered success is `no_matching_purchase`. Existing live tests unchanged; the pool grows from 8 to 16 connections for the held transactions.

Evidence:
- Failing-before: 2 failed / 31 passed, `tsc --noEmit` green — [run 37186266591](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186266591).
- After: 190 / 190 (live spec + 11 affected unit suites), `tsc --noEmit` green — [run 37186426457](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186426457).
- PR checks at this head, all SUCCESS: build-and-test, mwb-3-live-tests (runs this spec: PASS, nothing skipped), rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, community-live-tests, Schema parity, npm audit, size-label, deploy-readiness tests ([ci run 37186659563](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186659563)). CodeQL, danger, Banned cast tokens and build-sbom run only on PRs whose base is main, so they do not run here; they run on #661 once this lands in its branch. R75 run locally over this PR's range: no positive token change. ESLint clean.

READY FOR AUDIT

FIX ROUND 1 (OP-SIZE-118, operator agent 118, test move + merge-only) — growth-project-backend#702 @ 20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb

- Merged #661 @ f80f0088 (merge-only), then re-added `test/checkout-hosted-activation-once.spec.ts` byte-identical to the copy #661 carried at c7649169 (SHA-256 `fc2e00c2578c97db6404776bcaa7e5df0b7f49cf145662dda983c116f645298a`) in [20d2eb4f](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb). The file is added after the merge, so later restacks cannot delete it.
- Integrated tree unchanged: `4339454c6a8eab6da9715a1b68f73946d670f006` at both 5c25122d and 20d2eb4f.
- Size: 513 changed lines, 2 files (the live settlement spec edit from B-661-R7-117 plus the moved spec).

READY FOR AUDIT follows when the required checks are green at this head.

READY FOR AUDIT (OP-SIZE-118, operator agent 118) — growth-project-backend#702 @ 20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb

Every required check is green at this exact head (11 checks: all success, one skipped by design). Content statement: FIX ROUND 7 (B-661-R7-117) plus the operator size move (FIX ROUND 8 on #661 / FIX ROUND 1 on #702). Lens pair AUD-OPUS-661-118 / AUD-SOL-661-118 is assigned.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#702 @ 20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb — VERDICT: APPROVE

A/B/C = 0/0/0

Lens: AUD-SOL-661-118, agent 118. Independent T4 audit of every line of this 513-line, two-file tests-only piece and its exact #661 source boundary; no candidate production code was edited. [Exact candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb)

- The moved hosted-activation spec is byte-identical to #661 before its size-only removal; it carries the real-handler/fanout hosted-decline/retry, owning-session, native-control, terminal-completion and exactly-once assertions, with no assertion weakening. The top tree equals the earlier `5c25122d` tree at `4339454c6a8eab6da9715a1b68f73946d670f006`; production/schema/dependency inputs equal exact #661 `f80f0088`. This is verified evidence applicability, not inherited other-lens approval. [Test move](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/702#issuecomment-5982239336) [Hosted cases](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb/test/checkout-hosted-activation-once.spec.ts)
- **Parent Sol B-661-3's final boundary is pinned:** real CheckoutService reservations and real decline adoptions run while native provider replies are held, legal unordered-read choices expose 9/10/12 boundaries, the activated owner recovers, adoptees gain nothing, one activation record remains, recovery adds no deferred split, and success redelivery is a no-op. Relation/one-time/subscription filters execute in PostgreSQL before the production cap; the spec's connection-pool increase supports twelve held transactions without replacing database behavior. [Live boundary cases](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb/test/checkout-settlement.live.spec.ts#L266-L466)
- The before/after live spec is blob-identical: against round-6 source the ten/twelve cases fail with `checkout_session_activates` (two failed / 31 passed), the nine control passes, and the fixed-source bundle passes 190/190; the before source equals `c7ee15f0`, after production inputs equal this candidate. [Failing-before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186266591) [Passing-after](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186426457)

### Fresh execution / exact-head CI

The fresh independent lane uses this exact production/schema/dependency tree plus test/setup files and its one-job wrapper (`e12d0db2acbc50153cd9fef541aa97928f220619`): **typecheck and 229/229 tests, 16/16 suites, zero skipped** pass, including both companion specs, the unchanged dead Sol native probe, new mixed-owner exclusion/concurrent recovery/rollback cases, and billing/first-payment/refund-decision/grant controls. The first lane stopped on the new lens fixture's omitted required `User.name`, before Jest; only that fixture was repaired. [Successful independent acceptance](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218577254) [Probe-only typecheck failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218328379)

The live head/checks were re-read before publication: **7/7 available main-required contexts SUCCESS** (build-and-test, RLS floor/live, MWB live, community live, schema parity, npm audit); the exact-head MWB default block is 74/74 with the settlement spec actually executed, plus the unchanged RLS/account-erasure live blocks. [Exact #702 CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218019543) [Exact #702 MWB job](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218019543/job/111482424039)

This approval is **stack-provisional for merge enforcement**, not permission to deploy #661 alone or retarget #702 independently: CodeQL, danger, Banned cast tokens and build-sbom are main-base-only and absent on this stacked head, so all eleven contexts must be green on the operator's final combined bottom/main-targeting candidate after top-down integration under rule 11. No source or workflow enforcement change is present in #702. [Stack opening/landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/702#issuecomment-5977876193) [Atomic test move](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/702#issuecomment-5982239336)

No new A/B/C belongs to this diff; parent C-661-13 copy and historical cleanup/recurring composition/index obligations remain parent/operator follow-ups. Recommended default: land the audited pair together after both lenses and combined-head required CI; no production/real-Stripe/release readiness claim. [Parent integration obligations](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/661#issuecomment-5977850515)

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#702 @ 20d2eb4f696f5e9b4966000f88bd1cdf76ba4ddb — VERDICT: APPROVE

A/B/C = 0/0/1

Lens: AUD-OPUS-661-118 (operator agent 118). Tier T4: tests-only, but it is the regression proof for #661's money and entitlement fix, and the two PRs land as one (rule 11). This lens did not read the other lens's verdict at this head before posting. The companion #661 verdict is at `f80f0088`.

### Scope
- **Diff against the base** `agent/clinic/b-secrets-3` @ `f80f0088`: 2 files, +509/-4. There is no source, schema, workflow or dependency change, and no banned cast token.
- **`test/checkout-settlement.live.spec.ts` (+231/-4):** the round-7 block `B-661-3 round 7: the owner query is complete at any number of adopted purchases`, run with 9, 10 and 12 adoptions. The pool goes from 8 to 16 connections. Every line was read:
  - Each adopted row is a real `CheckoutService.createPaymentIntentForClient` reservation, with the provider reply held.
  - A real `payment_intent.payment_failed` metadata-fallback delivery adopts each one, in its own held transaction.
  - The owner then goes through a real completion, a real failure and a real success.
  - `legalOrder` answers only unordered reads, in a legal adversarial order: `findMany` newest first, `findFirst` oldest first.
  - The boundary is asserted, not assumed. There are `count + 1` failed rows and one activation record, and an unfiltered ten-row read misses the owner from ten rows on.
  - The outcome is asserted in full: `payment_recovered` with no split descriptor, the owner paid / entitled / drop pending, the adopted rows unchanged, one PurchaseFanout row, every native reply ending on its own PI, and a redelivery that is `no_matching_purchase`.
  - The `finally` releases every held reply and transaction, so a failure cannot leak connections into the next spec.
- **`test/checkout-hosted-activation-once.spec.ts` (+278):** moved from #661.
  - It is byte-identical to the copy #661 carried at `c7649169`: SHA-256 `fc2e00c2…`, verified from both git objects.
  - It equals the file this lens approved at `957e3677`, plus one double line (`findMany`) from round 6.
  - It is added after the merge, so a later restack cannot drop it.
- **Merges:** `5c25122d` and `b261dd1f` are automatic. `b261dd1f`'s tree `28cbca22` equals `git merge-tree 5c25122d f80f0088`. The integrated tree is `4339454c`, both at `5c25122d` and at this head, which is the tree audited for #661.
- **Piece boundary:** tests only. Every import exists in #661, and tsc is green on this tree with this lens's probe added (lane run below). Nothing imports a later piece.

### Evidence
- **Failing-before** [run 37186266591](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186266591), these tests against #661 `c7ee15f0`: 2 failed / 31 passed. Only the 10 and 12 cases fail, with `{ claimed: false, reason: 'checkout_session_activates' }`; the 9 case is the control.
- **After** [run 37186426457](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186426457): 190/190.
- **This lens's lane on this exact tree** ([run 37218675555](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218675555), real PostgreSQL 16.15, tsc green): 5 suites / 53 tests pass. They are:
  - this spec;
  - the moved spec;
  - `checkout-settlement-round5`;
  - the dead Sol lens AUD-SOL-661R6-117 probe (`661-native-verified`), unchanged;
  - this lens's probe `test/aud-opus-661-118.live.spec.ts`. Its O1 puts an owner behind 30 never-activated rows and 5 activated non-owners. It fails at the `c7ee15f0` control ([run 37218911726](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218911726)), so the boundary these tests pin is also caught well past 12 rows and against terminal and recurring activated rows.
- **Checks at this head:** every check that ran is green ([CI run 37218019543](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218019543)).
  - build-and-test: 729 suites passed, `checkout-hosted-activation-once` PASS.
  - mwb-3-live-tests: 8 suites / 74 tests, including the 9/10/12 cases, none skipped.
  - Also green: rls-live, community-live, rls-floor-guard, Schema parity and npm audit.
  - Branch protection requires no checks on this base. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run on #661 once this lands in its branch.
- **Size:** 513 changed lines.

### C findings
- **C-702-1 (docs):** the PR body is stale after FIX ROUND 1.
  - It says "One file, `test/checkout-settlement.live.spec.ts` (+231 / -4)" and "Size: 235 changed lines". It does not mention the moved `test/checkout-hosted-activation-once.spec.ts` (B-661-5 / C-661-7 hosted activation-once cases).
  - Rule: add the moved spec and its provenance (SHA-256, from #661 `c7649169`) to the acceptance evidence, and set the size to 513.

### Landing note
Merge this PR into `agent/clinic/b-secrets-3` before #661 lands on main; otherwise the hosted activation-once cases never reach main. A landed #661 head whose tree is `4339454c` is what this lens audited.

APPROVE: no A or B findings at this head. The tests prove the round-7 fix, with a failing-before at `c7ee15f0`. The moved spec is byte-identical, and the integrated tree is unchanged from `5c25122d`.
